_what: COBIx lane 1, Nov 28 2026: a verdict on each wrong answer the free found-page captures counted (the gate: none wrong). Evidence is each program's state title, award and listed courses against the page the lookup chose ('found') and the page its passing filed record was read from ('oracle'), compared on the share of the state's listed course codes each page prints. 'confirmed' means both pages were loaded and compared; 'probable' or 'unconfirmed' means the found page could not be loaded here (eLumen, CurriQunet and the Delta print view return no program text to a plain fetch) and the verdict rests on the oracle page's title and coverage alone. The gate was not changed: every wrong below still counts against its college.
